## Owner summary

State the change in no more than five plain-language lines.

## What is preserved

Confirm whether ingredient values, nutrition targets, profile names, feeding recommendations, safety rules, and user-facing baseline copy are unchanged. List every exception.

## Owner decision requested

State the exact approval, rejection, or test feedback needed. Do not merge until the product owner approves.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test:calculator`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Fixed outputs reviewed for affected pigeon fixtures

## Detail links

Link to any evidence note, benchmark, screenshot, or migration note that supports the change.
